title: The back page, under the lamp
logline: A 1997 Timberline back page under the green lamp. The first strip, #1, in a stranger's folder, in the town's archive. A cardigan on the chair. He is not in the room.

panels.composition: Close on the reading-room table: the green-shaded lamp, its light a circle on a yellowed newsprint back page — the Timberline, September 12, 1997, the first Drift Wood strip readable in it, the three-legged-table gag in Era I's crow-quill line, redrawn now by the older hand exactly as it was. At the circle's edge, the sleeve of a cardigan on the chair back. No one.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close view of a library reading-room table under a green-shaded lamp whose circle of light falls on a yellowed 1997 high-school newspaper back page containing a crude four-panel comic strip drawn in scratchy crow-quill style, a cardigan sleeve on the chair back at the edge of the light, nobody present, no words
image.notes: The strip inside the page is Era I's line, reproduced by Era IV's hand. Two lines on one page.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: #1, under the lamp, in the archive. Era I inside Era IV.
